paper.title_en: $B \to D$ form factors from light-cone sum rules
paper.abstract_en: We present a light-cone sum rule (LCSR) analysis of the $B\to D$ transition form factors $f_+^{BD}(q^2)$ and $f_0^{BD}(q^2)$ in the large-recoil region, including the next-to-leading-power corrections at tree level. The non-perturbative input is provided by the leading-twist $D$-meson distribution amplitude determined from lattice QCD in the heavy-quark large-momentum effective theory (HQLaMET) framework, which enters together with the twist-three and twist-four distribution amplitudes of the $D$ meson fixed by the QCD equations of motion. A combined fit to the LCSR results at $q^2\lesssim2$~GeV$^2$ and to the FNAL/MILC and HPQCD lattice data at $q^2\gtrsim8.5$~GeV$^2$, performed in the model-independent Boyd-Grinstein-Lebed (BGL) parametrisation, allows us to obtain the form factors over the whole physical range and to extract $|V_{cb}|$ from the semileptonic $B\to D\ellν$ decay as well as the lepton-flavour universality ratio $R(D)$.
